title: SAML 2.0 Setup Assistant with federation hints, clock-skew tolerance, and offline metadata replay
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an improved SAML 2.0 setup assistant that reduces failed onboarding by validating metadata aggressively but forgivingly: provide federation hints, detect and surface clock-skew issues, validate certificate chains and signature algorithms, and accept an offline metadata bundle for air-gapped IdPs. This ticket covers backend validation service, interactive UX flows, audit logging hooks, RBAC mapping templates for admin review, and telemetry to classify common failure modes.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive wizard can ingest XML metadata URL or uploaded metadata bundle and run a full validation pass (schema, EntityID uniqueness, assertion consumer service endpoints).
Certificate chain validation is performed and failures are surfaced with exact actionable guidance (expired cert, unsupported algorithm, missing X509Certificate element).
Clock skew detector runs a signed-assertion simulation and if skew > 5m suggests automatic skew-tolerant settings and documents manual IdP fixes.
Federation hinting: when metadata lists multiple Entities or an IdP proxy is detected, UI suggests primary entity and exposes a downstream selection for admins.
Offline metadata replay: admin can upload a metadata ZIP (metadata.xml + certs.pem) and the backend validates it identically to URL-based flow with same warnings and audit logs.
RBAC v2 mapping templates are surfaced as recommended claims-to-role mappings; templates saved to tenant-settings for later reuse.
All validation steps emit structured audit events (validation.start, validation.warning, validation.failure, validation.success) with correlation ID and user token, surfaced in Console audit logs.
End-to-end integration tests exist covering the 4 primary failure modes: malformed XML, missing certificate, clock skew, and duplicate entity IDs.
Security review completed and signed off prior to release and feature gated behind SSO developer flag.
Documentation and admin-runbook drafted with screenshots and remediation steps.
technical_notes: Implement a standalone metadata-validator service that performs schema validation, certificate parsing, signature verification, and a simulated AuthnRequest/Response roundtrip against a dry-run probe. Use established XML parser with hardened XXE protections. For offline bundles accept zipped artifacts, validate file types, and canonicalize cert PEM entries. Emit detailed diagnostic codes for telemetry (e.g., VAL_CERT_EXPIRED, VAL_XML_MALFORMED, VAL_CLOCK_SKEW_HIGH). Persist validation snapshots to a tenant-scoped S3 bucket for debugging with access controls.
migration_plan: Phased rollout: feature-flagged rollout to 10% orgs, run side-by-side with legacy wizard. Provide automated import tool to convert existing connector configs to new normalized metadata snapshots. Notify customers with custom connectors and provide a migration runbook. Decommission old wizard after 6 weeks of stable telemetry and zero regressions.
